notes: Faster launch: Monaco editor and fonts now ship inside the app instead of loading from a CDN — no network round-trip before the editor is ready.
Returning users skip the splash screen entirely; the home screen paints immediately.
New cornered tab strip, with the same enter/exit, icon-pop and label animations.
Activity heatmap now paints in idle time, off the critical startup path.
Requires Roblox 0.745.0.7451137. If you are on a different build, re-run the install script — it pins the right one.
